milestone: Immutable CPU String arrays, String-valued maps and retained local worker results

implementation.source: Typed/inferred homogeneous [String] literals, contextual empties, length, checked indexing, conditional arrays, named/anonymous bidirectional numeric/Bool/record/String maps, captures, local modules and structured worker recovery
implementation.storage: Contiguous owned array of managed String descriptors; empty canonical descriptors; immutable text sharing through retained backing references
implementation.validation: Complete outer descriptor and UTF-8/owner validation of every element; helper/length/map/worker/display boundaries poll cooperatively; partial retention settles before publication
implementation.CLI: Separate private String array executable entry preserves existing numeric/Bool display code; quote/escape controls, preserve Unicode, honor --limit/--all, validate hidden tail and retain dependencies before source settlement and output
implementation.limits: String-array record fields, nested arrays, String tensors, whole-array equality/concatenation, GPU Strings, native distributed transport and public C/C++ interfaces remain gated/separate

coverage: Empty arrays and elements, Unicode/NUL text, quoted/escaped controls, display limits, scalar String selected and returned from a worker
String to numeric/Bool/record maps and numeric/Bool/record to String maps; captured arrays, nested callbacks, imported helpers and contextual empty maps
Nested workers, cached/repeated awaits, shared text across array elements, source settlement and results retained beyond scheduler destruction
Malformed outer storage and late String descriptors; partial owner failure leaves output sentinels untouched and settles acquired owners
Cancellation/deadlines/admission/scheduler allocation failures; cancellation during validation of a long String element
String array TaskError recovery/rethrow and retained managed diagnostic text
Whole-array deep validation before CLI printing even when limit hides the malformed tail; no partial stdout on validation failure
Strict source and forged IR typing; String tensors, nested arrays, mixed elements and String-array record fields remain rejected with output artifacts preserved
Documentation example compiled and executed in each variant
Existing scalar String workers, String record fields, record arrays, Bool arrays, numeric/Bool collection CLI and semantics/continuation regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification, not a full-suite or fresh GPU execution claim. Optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses using the existing runtime archive.
qualification.build_notes: No production source changes after the successful focused run. Existing frontend regressions were freshly relinked; source-driven regressions compile with current compiler/runtime. Former String-array rejection assertions were removed after adding positive array/map coverage before final qualification.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Add checked String-array validation call; existing numeric checked-call rules retained
